about: The key3 device of the simulator's catalogue (c/sim/devices.c), as devices/apps/key3: three keys on endpoints 4, 5, 6, features RAW and HOLD, NO MULTICLICK — a combination no other device has. EventMode then switches between CLICK and RAW only: MULTICLICK is a value out of range (types/0x0010-key-input.md §2.3), and the multi-click attributes belong to an undeclared feature. With no multi-click window a Click comes right after the release. DeviceType 0x0011 is the model (zadania/zrobione/FEAT-09.md, N3). A LOW pin is a press.

steps.note: the first key held, in CLICK
the second key, still CLICK: the refused write never landed
Click x1 at once — no multi-click window to wait out
